Google Maps' Biggest Android Auto Upgrade Is Reaching More Users

2026-07-27 Moinak Pal / Digital Trends Google Maps, Android Auto, Immersive Navigation, live speedometer, Gemini, server-side rollout, CarPlay
Read the source article

Quick summary

Google is widening the rollout of Immersive Navigation and a built-in live speedometer for Android Auto users, with both features now reaching stable Google Maps builds rather than remaining exclusive to beta testers.

Key takeaways

  • Google is expanding rollout of two long-awaited Google Maps features for Android Auto: Immersive Navigation and a built-in live speedometer
  • Both features are now reaching stable builds of Google Maps, not just beta versions, making them accessible to a much wider audience
  • Immersive Navigation displays richer road layouts, clearer lane guidance, and more detailed intersections designed for glanceable interpretation while driving
  • The live speedometer displays the vehicle's current speed directly within Google Maps, reducing the need to switch attention between the infotainment display and the instrument cluster
  • The rollout is server-side, meaning installing the latest app version does not guarantee immediate access; the Gemini icon has replaced the Google Assistant shortcut in Maps' top-right corner
